annotations.title: Subset a layer to a polygon selection

description: Create a new layer containing the source layer's features that lie within the supplied polygon. The source layer is untouched. Useful for "show me only the X inside this country/bbox/hand-drawn shape."

inheritStyle.description: Default true. false emits a new layer with minimal default styling.

newLayerId.description: Id for the new layer. Must not already be in use in this workspace.

rationale.description: Optional short label (≤300 chars) for the map edit history, e.g. "add wildfire layer". Omit it to send nothing beyond the tool arguments.

selection.description: GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon in [lng,lat] coordinate order.

name: select_within
title: Subset a layer to a polygon selection
